title: Create Backpack Upgrades
description: This project adds two (More to come) backpack upgrades to the sophisticated backpack mod and the Create Mod.
body: This mod adds two different backpack upgrades for the create mod. The first one is for pressing which lets you press items in your backpack with no rotatonal power neaded. The second one the Mixer upgrade lets you use the create mixing upgrades from within your invintory.
